title: Abstract Product Loading
short_description: Create a clear API for loading products through a replaceable dependency.
description: App.vue already provides a fetchProducts function to the composable and consumes its public state.
Complete useProductLoader to encapsulate loading, state, and errors without knowing the UI or data source.
instructions: Enable loading and clear any previous error when a request begins.
Run the received loadProducts function and store its result in products.
If the operation fails, assign the specified message to the error ref.
Make sure loading is disabled whether the operation succeeds or fails.
You only need to modify useProductLoader.ts.

hints.title: Explicit dependency
hints.body: Do not call `fetch` directly: call `loadProducts`, which is already received as a composable argument.

hints.title: Operation state
hints.body: Before awaiting, set `loading.value` to `true` and `error.value` to an empty string.

hints.title: Guaranteed completion
hints.body: A `try/catch/finally` block separates result handling, error handling, and `loading` cleanup.
